get.summary: Lists the active login providers.
Starts a login with the provider and redirects back to returnUrl (an app-relative path) afterwards.

post.summary: Ends the session (and the IdP session for OIDC logins) and redirects to the login page.

get.summary: 200 while the instance owner is unclaimed and the first-run setup is available, otherwise 404.

post.summary: Claims the instance owner: sets user name, display name and password, grants admin and signs in.
Signs in with user name and password.
WebAuthn request options (PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptions JSON) for passkey login.
Signs in with a passkey assertion (PublicKeyCredential JSON).
WebAuthn creation options (PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions JSON) to add a passkey to the signed-in user.
Stores a passkey attestation for the signed-in user.

get.summary: The current user: id, display name, roles and scopes.
A token for the X-XSRF-TOKEN header of state-changing requests. Fetch a new one after login or logout.
Server-sent live updates for the comma-separated topics (event name = event type, data = LiveEventMessage).
The user's runs (voice, web, task, api), newest first or slowest time to first delta first (sort=timeToFirstDelta); filter by source, outcome and minimum cost, page with before.
One run: context build, model calls, tool calls with guard decisions, taint sources and the reply.
Cost per day and tier in the user's time zone, advisor separately (default: the last 30 days).
The app version, the supported and deprecated API versions and the event sources.
Loaded skills, templates, MCP servers, risk rules, models and satellites, plus the last load error per file.

post.summary: Runs one conversation turn and streams the reply as server-sent events (delta, status, artifact, final; web sessions also reasoning and tool).

get.summary: The user's conversations (web, voice, api), newest last turn first; page with before (a lastTurnAt) and limit.
One conversation: its turns and background results in time order.
The user's notifications, newest first, with channel, outcome and reason; filter by outcome, page with before.
The artifact's content (session or token).
A PNG preview within 480 × 270 pixels for 3D models and images; 404 for other kinds.
The artifact's content through a signed, expiring link; no sign-in.

post.summary: Copies a printer snapshot into the artifact store, outside the snapshot retention.
Receives a webhook of a source (e.g. uptime-kuma) and publishes its events.

get.summary: The user's API tokens without secrets; executor callback tokens are read-only.

post.summary: Creates a token with scopes the user holds; the plaintext is returned only in this response.

delete.summary: Revokes one of the user's tokens.

get.summary: Every secret visible to the user (own, instance, environment) without values, plus unresolved references.

put.summary: Creates or replaces one of the user's secrets.

delete.summary: Deletes one of the user's secrets.

get.summary: Instance secrets (database and environment) without values.

put.summary: Creates or replaces an instance secret.

get.summary: Language, time zone, quiet hours, notification targets and do-not-disturb of the user.
Chunks newest first, or ranked by relevance with query; filter by type, scope, projectId and pinned.

post.summary: Writes a chunk through its deterministic id (an existing chunk with the same identity is updated).

get.summary: A chunk (also when deleted) with its earlier versions and its edges.

put.summary: Changes content, importance and source; the previous content becomes a version.

delete.summary: Soft-deletes a chunk; it is no longer retrieved.

put.summary: Pins a chunk: it is injected in full in every turn.

post.summary: Writes a replacement with a new identity and a supersedes edge to the chunk.

get.summary: Predecessors, earlier versions and the current content, oldest first.
Stale chunks, open contradictions, orphans and dangling edges.
Live chunks and the edges between them, for the force-directed graph.
Live chunks' embeddings projected onto their first two principal components.
Chunks, versions, edges and projects as NDJSON (without embeddings).
Live projects with aliases, alias candidates and chunk counts.

post.summary: Creates a project; names are unique.

delete.summary: Deletes a project; its chunks stay and show up as orphans in the audit.

post.summary: Adds an active alias (or activates an existing candidate).

put.summary: Promotes or rejects an alias or alias candidate.

delete.summary: Removes an alias or alias candidate.

get.summary: The project's correction log, newest first.
Configured printers with their live state (null while offline), allowlisted macros and babysitter state (null when not enabled).
Live state from the websocket cache.
Printable files, newest first.
The job queue.
Recent jobs, newest first.

post.summary: Runs a safe control, or freezes a confirm-tier control and returns its confirmation token.
Runs a frozen control with the token from the confirmation dialog (single use, expires).
Takes, resizes and stores a webcam snapshot.

get.summary: A stored snapshot as JPEG.
A stored snapshot as JPEG without signing in, with the signature of a shared link (push notification images; expires after a day).
The webcam's live stream, proxied so the browser never contacts the printer.
The user's mail accounts without credentials.

post.summary: Adds an IMAP account; the password becomes a write-only owner secret.

delete.summary: Removes an account and its stored credential.

get.summary: OAuth providers and whether this instance has a client for them.

post.summary: Starts connecting an account: returns the provider's sign-in URL for the browser.

get.summary: Undecided approvals of the user's background tasks, oldest first, with reasons and taint sources.

post.summary: Executes the frozen action and resumes the task with its result.
Resumes the task with the rejection; nothing is executed.

get.summary: The user's tasks and watches, oldest first; status filters by one status or active (pending, running, waiting).
Whether background work is stopped.

post.summary: Stops every unfinished agent task and pauses new ones until released.
Lets background tasks run again; tasks paused while it was active become due.

get.summary: One task with notes, the latest result, deliveries, recent runs, notifications and executor sessions.

put.summary: Replaces the task's goal; the next run uses it.

post.summary: Cancels the task and its unfinished child tasks.

get.summary: The user's proposals, newest first, without diffs (default: open ones; status=all for every one).
One proposal with its diff.

post.summary: Merges the change into the branch it started from on the executor host; a conflict leaves it open.
Rejects the change and drops its branch on the executor host.

get.summary: The owner's artifacts, newest first, filtered by kind, source and name, with the quota usage.

post.summary: Uploads one file (multipart field 'file'), at most artifacts.maxUploadMb.

readOnly.description: True for tokens users cannot manage (executor callback tokens).

ApiTokenResponse.description: A machine token without its secret.

taskId.description: The task that waits for the decision.

runId.description: The run that asked; with a taint source's first step it links to the tool result that tainted the run.

arguments.description: Frozen arguments; approving executes exactly these.

reasons.description: Why it needs approval, verbatim, the main one first.

taint.description: Untrusted sources the run had read, with the step that brought each in.

ApprovalItem.description: A background approval in the review queue.

ArtifactList.description: Artifacts with the owner's storage usage.

sourceReference.description: Task, message or printer snapshot it came from.

tainted.description: Content or name can carry third-party text.

ChunkEditRequest.description: New content of a chunk; identity fields cannot change (supersede instead).

title.description: Short English title (part of the identity).

ChunkWriteRequest.description: A chunk to write (create or supersede replacement).

message.description: What is wrong (never contains secret values).

previousVersionActive.description: True when the previous version of the file stays active; false when the entry is skipped.

ConfigError.description: A config file whose last load failed.

templates.description: Loaded agent templates, including the built-in default unless replaced.

mcpServers.description: Configured MCP servers with their connection status.

riskRules.description: Active risk rules in evaluation order (first match wins).

models.description: Configured models; API keys by secret name only.

conversationId.description:
Token clients: their own conversation id (required). Browser sessions: Marshal's session id
from an earlier final event; omitted starts a new conversation.

text.description: What the user said or typed.

language.description: Request language (`de` or `en`); the reply uses it.

haUserId.description: Home Assistant user id, if known.

inputMode.description: `voice` when the turn went through speech-to-text, otherwise `text`.

followupRef.description: Opaque reference from a voice follow-up; unknown values are ignored.

name.description: Label, e.g. the client using it.

scopes.description: Scopes to grant; each must be one the user holds.

token.description: The plaintext; shown only in this response.

port.description: IMAP port (993 for TLS, 143 for STARTTLS).

draftsFolder.description: Drafts folder when the server marks none with `\Drafts`.

CreateMailAccountRequest.description: A new IMAP account with a password or app password. The password becomes a write-only owner secret.

enabled.description: Unconfigured integrations are simulated and demo data is seeded.

showBadge.description: Show the "Demo" badge in the navigation.

DemoInfo.description: Demo mode as the UI needs it.

connected.description: Whether it currently receives events (webhook sources: a webhook arrived in the last 24 hours).

webhook.description: Whether it is a webhook source (`POST /api/v1/hooks/{source}`).

lastReceivedAt.description: When it last received a webhook; null for other sources or before the first one.

EventSourceInfo.description: An event source and its state.

cancelled.description: On activation: how many tasks were cancelled.

type.description: Event type, e.g. `run.completed` (also the SSE event name).

LocalSetupRequest.description: First-run setup: the instance owner's login.

LocalSetupStatus.description: Whether the first-run setup is available.

LoginProviderInfo.description: A login provider as shown on the login page.

alias.description: Alias used as the tools' `account` argument.

MailAccountItem.description: A mail account without its credentials.

MailOAuthProvider.description: An OAuth provider and whether this instance has a client for it.

untrusted.description: Its tool output taints the run.

authTokenSecret.description: Secret name of the bearer token, if any.

environmentSecrets.description: Secret names passed as environment variables (stdio).

untrustedTools.description: Globs on reported tool names whose output taints the run (with `Untrusted` false).

warnings.description: Problems that leave the server usable, e.g. an `untrustedTools` glob that matches no tool.

edges.description: Edges from and to the chunk.

MemoryChunkDetail.description: A chunk with its history data.

displayName.description: Name used in the UI and the system prompt.

scopes.description: Scopes: granted by the roles for cookie sessions, the token's own for tokens.

demo.description: Whether the instance runs in demo mode and shows the badge.

apiKeySecret.description: Secret name of the API key, if any.

PasskeyOptionsRequest.description: Passkey login options; without a user name the options allow any discoverable passkey.

PasskeyRegistrationRequest.description: A new passkey for the signed-in user.

action.description:
start_print, pause, resume, cancel, emergency_stop, set_temperature, home, move, run_macro,
queue_add, queue_remove, queue_clear, queue_pause, queue_start or queue_jump.

axes.description: x, y and / or z for home (all when empty).

axis.description: x, y or z for move.

PrinterControlRequest.description: A printer page control. `action` names the command; the other fields are its arguments.

description.description: What the control does, for the dialog.

PrinterControlResult.description: Outcome of a control: `done`, or `confirmation_required` with a token for the dialog.

PrinterSummary.description: A printer with its live state (null while offline), its macros and its own web UI, if configured.

ProjectRequest.description: Name and description of a project.

denyTools.description: Tool globs hidden on this satellite.

denyConfirm.description: Tool globs whose confirm-tier calls are refused on this satellite.

updatedAt.description: Last change of a database secret.

readOnly.description: True when the current user cannot change it here.

SecretOverview.description: The secrets view: every visible secret and every reference that does not resolve.

SecretValueRequest.description: A secret value to store. It is never returned.

files.description: Additional files, relative to the skill.

email.description: The mailbox address (the IMAP login name).

StartMailOAuthRequest.description: Starts connecting an account through OAuth.

StartMailOAuthResponse.description: Where the browser goes to sign in with the provider.

version.description: App version (informational version, including the commit when built from source).

supportedApiVersions.description: API versions this build serves, e.g. `1.0`.

deprecatedApiVersions.description: Supported versions that will be removed.

eventSources.description: What publishes events on the event bus (HA, printers, mail, webhook sources).

simulatedIntegrations.description: Integrations demo mode simulates (`home_assistant`, `printers`, `mail`, `rss`, `notes`); empty without demo mode.

TaskBudgetView.description: Limits of a task over one activation; null limits are not enforced at the task level.

cancelled.description: How many tasks were cancelled (the task and its unfinished descendants).

notes.description: Notes the task keeps between runs.

result.description: The latest result: speech and markdown body.

overrideQuietHoursUntil.description: Until when it may notify during quiet hours.

notifications.description: What it sent and what the router did, newest first.

executorSessions.description: External work it started, newest first.

TaskDetail.description: One task with everything the detail view shows.

goal.description: The goal the next run works on.

TaskGoalUpdate.description: A new goal for a task.

statusReason.description: Why it is in that state (e.g. `budget_exceeded`, `paused`).

trigger.description: What makes it due; watches have kind `event`.

spent.description: What the current activation has used.

resultSpeech.description: The spoken part of the latest result.

resultAt.description: When the latest result was ready.

TaskItem.description: A task or watch in the tasks list.

TaskSpendView.description: What a task's current activation has used, in the shape of .

modelTier.description: Fixed model tier; null = by input mode.

tools.description: Tool id globs it may use.

skills.description: Skills it may use; null = all.

UnresolvedSecret.description: A referenced secret that no source provides.

language.description: `de` or `en`; used when a request has no language.

quietHours.description: Weekly quiet-hour windows; an end before the start ends the next day.

UserPreferencesResponse.description: A user's preferences. Content preferences (briefing topics, interests) live in memory, not here.
